body.name: \(\mathcal Q_8\)
body.construction: At horizon \(8\), draw \(U_{t,a}\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\operatorname{Unif}[-B/2,B/2]\) before assignment. The null \(Q_0^{(8)}\) sets \(Y_t(z_{1:t})=U_{t,z_t}\). For each offset \(r\in\{0,1\}\), draw independent \(\xi_{I,a}^{(r)}\in\{-1,1\}\); the prior \(Q_{8,r}^{\mathrm{blk}}\) sets \(Y_t(z_{1:t})=\psi_{\delta_8\xi_{I,z_t}^{(r)}}(U_{t,z_t})\) on the unique block \(I\in\mathcal I_{8,r}\) containing \(t\). For each arm \(a\in\mathcal A\), set \(h_{1,a}^{(8)}=0\) and \(h_{t,a}^{(8)}(z)=\mathbf 1\{z_t=a\}[c_1-2c_1\mathbf 1\{z_{t-1}\ne a\}]_+\); the prior \(Q_{8,a}^{\mathrm{band}}\) sets \(Y_t(z_{1:t})=\psi_{s_a\eta_8h_{t,a}^{(8)}(z)}(U_{t,z_t})\). The worked family is \(\mathcal Q_8=\{Q_0^{(8)},Q_{8,0}^{\mathrm{blk}},Q_{8,1}^{\mathrm{blk}},Q_{8,0}^{\mathrm{band}},Q_{8,1}^{\mathrm{band}}\}\).
